Using integration by parts with \( \log(x**3) \):

\[
\int -3*log(x**3)\,dx
= -3*\left(x*log(x**3) - 3*x\right) + C
\]

\[
= -3*x*log(x**3) + 9*x + C
\]

<answer>
-3*x*log(x**3) + 9*x + C
</answer>
